static_traits.name: Lindsay
static_traits.social_status: Relationship with colleagues affected，在Work中倾向于自我孤立；有少数朋友可交流，但尚not yet与他们讨论相关感受。
static_traits.medical_history: 既往not yet出现类似心理问题；without心理治疗史；No major physical illness。
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、语气中立；能具体描述trigger情境与自动化思维；在比较他人时倾向negate积极信息；愿意尝试改变但存在犹疑。

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己从事的without人机制造Worknot重要、not独特，因此感到被贬低与缺乏意义。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling now because this feeling of being devalued is affecting my work performance and overall well-being.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人被认可而我have not，就说明我的Worknot重要、I have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尝试将注意力转向自己的skill与成就来证明价值

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能在会议中表现得与众not同，就证明I am not good enough、not值得被重视
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在Work中Keeping distance from coworkers、减少参与以降低Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，大家会觉得我很平庸。

special_situations.event: 看到do not人成功而自己感到停滞
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人持续被认可而我have not，就意味着我以后也not会被看到和重视
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断与他人比较来评估自我价值
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not会像同事那样被认可或被重视。

special_situations.event: The team's informal appreciation of my contributions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not是公开、显著的认可，正面反馈就not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或弱化积极反馈，继续关注自身的not足
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些赞赏not重要，我仍然not够好。

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen, to have unique and valuable work and self
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被忽视与贬低，担心自己被证明为“普通且not重要”
defense_goal: 通过自我疏离和negate积极反馈来降低被比较与被评判的伤害感

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师提示其关注正面证据或强调其独特skill、价值时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的成功体验为对自身的negate；把咨询师的肯定理解为与现实not符，进一步Reinforcement“I am not good enough”的自我图式
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自责的语气强调自己“not够好”，弱化或negate正面反馈；当被询问成功经验时，简短回应并迅速转回自身not足。

manifestations: After a colleague is recognized, persistently feels devalued and purposeless
在团队会议与展示时更明显地体验到Meaninglessness感
outcomes: Increased anxiety，日常作息与自我照料被扰乱

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 在叙述中频繁Self-denial与缩小化优点
Overly cautious about expressing self-worth, prioritizing attention on others' success
Chooses self-isolation in the workplace to avoid being evaluated

positive_force: Has the professional ability to quickly troubleshoot complex problems (colleagues once appreciated their contributions)
能够识do not并描述trigger情境与自动化思维
Willing to try alternative perspectives and take small steps (such as reminding oneself of one's contributions before meetings)
Has a few friends as potential support resources
negative_force: 持续的比较与despair思维，依赖外部认可定义自我价值
negate正面思考与心理过滤，缩小化积极反馈
Self-isolates at work, reducing contact with colleagues
Work意义感低导致Decreased motivation and satisfaction，并伴随Increased anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: 在团队会议/项目展示中出现Anxiety、Self-deprecation并回避/疏离同事
antecedent: Situations where colleagues get praised or succeed
Moments of comparing her own work with others
target_behavior.core_reason: 将自我价值与外部认可紧密绑定；习惯性比较导致形成“我的Worknot重要/not独特”的认知，并对积极反馈进行心理过滤与negate
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评价与比较带来的Anxiety与羞耻，寻求短期的安全感与Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: WorkDecreased motivation and satisfaction、绩效受损；与同事Relationship estrangement；日常作息与自我照料被扰乱
